source.committedReadonly: Ownership moved successfully. This source copy is permanently read-only.
source.description: Choose a paired standalone device or configured Host. This source freezes before ownership moves.
source.failed: The handoff could not be started or resumed.
source.frozenReadonly: The source is frozen while the target verifies and accepts the transcript. Zero writable copies are allowed during recovery.
source.lossDisclosure: The target checks provider, model, credential, Workspace, protocol, and attachments. If a native runtime cannot be restored, it will disclose transcript-seeded continuation before accepting.
source.noDevices: No eligible devices or Hosts are configured. Pair a standalone device or add a remote Host first.
source.started: The source is frozen and the handoff offer is queued.
source.stranded: Delivery exhausted its retries. Retry it or complete coordinated recovery from the target; this source will not unfreeze itself.
source.title: Continue on another device

unavailable.not-mobile: This paired client is a control surface, not a standalone owner.
unavailable.standalone-required: Open standalone BYOK mode and reconnect so the device can report thread-handoff-v1.

source.remoteAvailable: Transfer ownership to this Host after preflight
source.remoteUnavailable: Host authorization or protocol upgrade required
source.remoteCompleted: Ownership transferred to the selected Host.
source.withCodeDescription: Hands over the working copy, uncommitted changes included. {host} continues in a fresh checkout of it.
source.withCodeUnsupported: Update {host} to bring the code along.
source.codeCompletedBranch: Continued on {host} with the code, on branch {branch}.

codeFailure.consent: Approve the request on {host}, then try again.
codeFailure.too-large: The working copy is larger than {host} accepts. Commit and push it, or raise the host's cap.
codeFailure.no-remote: {host} has no repository to start from. Record an https remote for this workspace, or push it first.
codeFailure.base-unavailable: {host} could not fetch the commit this copy starts from. Push it, then try again.
codeFailure.tree-mismatch: The copy on {host} did not match this one, so it was discarded. Nothing moved.
codeFailure.unsafe-archive: {host} refused the archive: it reached outside its folder.
codeFailure.integrity: The upload arrived damaged. Try again.
codeFailure.no-working-directory: This conversation has no working folder to hand over.
codeFailure.other: The code could not be handed over. Nothing moved.

inbound.decline: Keep it on the source device
inbound.degradedHint: You can continue, but the original native runtime handle will not be restored.
inbound.description: “{title}” is ready to move here. The source stays read-only until this device has accepted and committed the handoff.
inbound.failed: The handoff could not advance. It remains read-only and can be recovered safely.
inbound.fidelityLoss: This device will continue with {fidelity} fidelity using the transferred transcript.
inbound.permissionReset: Past tool approvals do not transfer. This device will ask again when a tool needs permission.
inbound.recoveryDescription: “{title}” was accepted here but the final ownership proof was interrupted. Resume to finish without creating two writable copies.
inbound.title: Continue this conversation here?

bringBack.title: This conversation continues on {host}
bringBack.actionDescription: Puts what was done on {host} into a new worktree here. This folder stays as it is.
bringBack.unsupported: Update {host} to bring its changes back here.

progress.apply: Checking the changes out into a new worktree…

bringBack.broughtBack: The changes from {host} are in a new worktree.
bringBack.alreadyHere: Nothing new since last time; this is the same worktree.
bringBack.notPushed: {host} could not push the branch, so the commits came over directly. Push it from the new worktree when you are ready.
bringBack.pullRequestBody: Work from a conversation continued on {host} with Cognia.
bringBack.pullRequestFailed: The pull request could not be opened.

failure.consent: Approve the request on {host}, then try again.
failure.unchanged: Nothing has changed on {host} since the conversation moved there.
failure.checkout-gone: {host} no longer has the copy this conversation worked in.
failure.fetch-failed: The branch could not be fetched from the repository. Check that you can pull from it here, then try again.
failure.mismatch: What arrived was not what {host} sent, so nothing was checked out.
failure.not-git: The folder this conversation started from is no longer a git checkout.
failure.too-large: The changes are larger than this device accepts.
failure.integrity: The download was interrupted or damaged. Try again.
failure.no-working-directory: This conversation has no folder on this device to bring the changes next to.
failure.other: The changes could not be brought back from {host}.
